### Write and index path

At Node server startup, [`src/instrumentation.ts`](</private/tmp/luna-scratch-20261008/5cf7f901-6d5a-4b2d-8466-a82879901c91/src/instrumentation.ts>) calls `registerEventHandlers()` in [`src/server/services/event-registry.ts`](</private/tmp/luna-scratch-20261008/5cf7f901-6d5a-4b2d-8466-a82879901c91/src/server/services/event-registry.ts>). That registers `registerSearchListeners()` from `search-service.ts` with the in-process event bus.

For a title edit, `updateIssueAction` in [`src/actions/issues/update-issue.ts`](</private/tmp/luna-scratch-20261008/5cf7f901-6d5a-4b2d-8466-a82879901c91/src/actions/issues/update-issue.ts>) runs through `withAction`: it validates `updateIssueSchema`, resolves the actor, and checks permission. It calls `updateIssue` in [`src/server/services/issue-service.ts`](</private/tmp/luna-scratch-20261008/5cf7f901-6d5a-4b2d-8466-a82879901c91/src/server/services/issue-service.ts>), which checks organization scope, permission, and archive status, then calls `issueRepo.updateIssue` in [`src/server/repositories/issue-repository.ts`](</private/tmp/luna-scratch-20261008/5cf7f901-6d5a-4b2d-8466-a82879901c91/src/server/repositories/issue-repository.ts>) to write the changed fields. After that write, the service awaits `emit("issue.updated", ...)`.

The event payload identifies the issue but does not carry its new title. The search listener therefore re-reads the issue with `findIssueById`, then calls `indexIssue`. That builds content from the title and description and calls `upsertSearchDocument` in [`src/server/repositories/search-repository.ts`](</private/tmp/luna-scratch-20261008/5cf7f901-6d5a-4b2d-8466-a82879901c91/src/server/repositories/search-repository.ts>). It updates the existing document, identified by organization, subject kind, and subject ID, or inserts one if absent. Since `emit` waits for its handlers to settle, the index update normally finishes before the issue update returns.

The copy is the `search_index` table defined in [`src/server/db/schema/webhooks.ts`](</private/tmp/luna-scratch-20261008/5cf7f901-6d5a-4b2d-8466-a82879901c91/src/server/db/schema/webhooks.ts>). Its rows store organization, subject kind and ID, project ID, searchable content, and `indexedAt`. Issue content is title plus description; comments store their body, and projects store name plus description.

There is a failure caveat: `emit` in [`src/lib/event-bus.ts`](</private/tmp/luna-scratch-20261008/5cf7f901-6d5a-4b2d-8466-a82879901c91/src/lib/event-bus.ts>) uses `Promise.allSettled` and reports handler errors without failing the write. So a search-indexing error can leave the copy stale even though the edit succeeds. `runSearchReindexJob` in [`src/server/jobs/search-reindex-job.ts`](</private/tmp/luna-scratch-20261008/5cf7f901-6d5a-4b2d-8466-a82879901c91/src/server/jobs/search-reindex-job.ts>) can rebuild documents for an organization after a bulk import or detected drift.

### Query and results path

The full-page search in [`src/app/(dashboard)/[orgSlug]/search/page.tsx`](</private/tmp/luna-scratch-20261008/5cf7f901-6d5a-4b2d-8466-a82879901c91/src/app/(dashboard)/[orgSlug]/search/page.tsx>) reads the query, loads the tenant and actor, and validates the input with `searchQuerySchema` from [`src/schemas/search.ts`](</private/tmp/luna-scratch-20261008/5cf7f901-6d5a-4b2d-8466-a82879901c91/src/schemas/search.ts>). It then calls `search` in `search-service.ts`. The quick-search API, `GET` in [`src/app/api/search/route.ts`](</private/tmp/luna-scratch-20261008/5cf7f901-6d5a-4b2d-8466-a82879901c91/src/app/api/search/route.ts>), performs its actor, organization, feature-flag, and schema checks before calling the same service. The service checks tenant scope and read permission, applies the organization’s search rate limit, and evaluates `advanced_search`.

`searchDocuments` in `search-repository.ts` filters by organization and uses a SQL `LIKE` substring match on content, with optional kind and project filters. It counts matches and returns a paginated set ordered by index time. `search` maps each row to a hit: the first content line becomes the title, `snippetAround` supplies nearby text, and `hrefFor` creates the destination. This is a denormalized substring index, not a full-text or status-aware query engine.

One valid-looking query can be refused after schema validation: `q: "status:done"` satisfies the schema, but `search` throws if the query contains a colon and `advanced_search` is off. That flag is enabled from the Enterprise plan or an organization override. As a result, even literal title text containing a colon can be refused on plans without the flag. When the flag is on, the repository still treats the query as a substring; it does not filter issues by status. In the Ctrl+K query parser, [`query-syntax.ts`](</private/tmp/luna-scratch-20261008/5cf7f901-6d5a-4b2d-8466-a82879901c91/src/components/domain/search/query-syntax.ts>), `kind:`/`in:` and `project:` are the recognized narrowing prefixes.

Search can also be refused when the organization’s rate-limit bucket is exhausted, or when the actor fails scope or permission checks.
